responsive.layout: Mobile viewports default to single-column card feeds with collapsible sidebar / drawer navigation and bottom sticky action bar. Desktop scales up to multi-column high-density bento grids (grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4). Heavy visual widgets stack vertically on screens under 768px with horizontal scrolling tables and touch-friendly swipe tabs.
responsive.typography: Mobile-first fluid scale using rem units. H1 starts at text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl. Body text is 1rem (16px) with py-3 inputs and 44px minimum tap targets to avoid mobile browser automatic zoom.
responsive.overflow_guard: All grid and flex containers must use min-w-0 and overflow-x-hidden on root containers to prevent unintended horizontal scrollbar bugs. Data tables wrap inside overflow-x-auto containers with sticky action columns.
responsive.tap_targets: All interactive elements, buttons, tabs, calendar dates, and action icons must have a minimum interactive tap target area of 44px x 44px (p-3 / h-11).

hierarchy.h1: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-extrabold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100
hierarchy.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-bold tracking-tight text-slate-900 dark:text-slate-100
hierarchy.small: text-xs sm:text-sm font-medium tracking-wide uppercase text-slate-500 dark:text-slate-400

colors.surface_rules: Never use pure #000000 or full transparent backgrounds on dropdowns/modals. Always add subtle tinting to neutrals. Headers and overlays must use backdrop-blur-xl with semi-opaque surfaces (e.g. bg-white/90 dark:bg-slate-900/90 border-b border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800).

layout_and_grids.grid_mode: MODE B: High Density Dashboard Grid
layout_and_grids.card_style: Flat background with sharp subtle rounded corners (rounded-lg or rounded-xl), 1px stroke border (border-slate-200 dark:border-slate-800), micro-shadow on hover (hover:shadow-md hover:border-slate-300 dark:hover:border-slate-700 transition-all duration-200).

key_components.name: DashboardOverview
key_components.description: Metric cards (Active Contracts, Interventions Planned, Distance Saved via Route Optimization, Sync Status with Google Calendar) + Upcoming Interventions Timeline.

key_components.name: ContractManager
key_components.description: CRUD table and detailed modal/drawer for client contracts including total days, scheduled vs remaining days, daily rate, client contact info, address, notes, and priority badges.

key_components.name: PlanningGenerator
key_components.description: Optimized Planning Engine combining OpenStreetMap geocoding distance grouping with strict deadline constraints. Generates proposed intervention slots with route efficiency scores.

key_components.name: CalendarView
key_components.description: Monthly and Weekly interactive intervention views with Google Calendar sync triggers, drag/reassign slots, client location badges, and conflict flags.

key_components.name: ClientRegistryAndMap
key_components.description: Anagrafica Clienti with interactive map view of client offices/sites, contact person details, phone numbers, total interventions completed, and distance matrix.

key_components.name: InvoiceGenerator
key_components.description: PDF Invoice creator upon contract completion. Calculates total daily rate * days worked, tax breakdown (Ritenuta d'acconto / Marca da bollo / IVA / Regime Forfettario options for IT consultants), with downloadable PDF preview.

key_components.name: GoogleAuthBar
key_components.description: Single-user Emergent Google Auth status, sync settings, last Google Calendar sync timestamp indicator, and manual sync action button.

icons.usage_rules: Never use AI emojis (🤖, 🧠, 💡) for navigation or badges. Use explicit Lucide icons: Calendar, MapPin, FileText, UserCheck, Route, ShieldCheck, RefreshCw, Plus, Download, Filter, Search, CheckCircle2, AlertTriangle, Clock, Euro.

instructions_to_main_agent: Develop JavaScript (.js / .jsx) files in React with Tailwind CSS and Shadcn primitives.
Target language is ITALIAN throughout all UI elements, labels, buttons, forms, tooltips, and toasts.
Ensure mobile-first responsive layout across all screens (grid-cols-1 on mobile, grid-cols-2/3/4 on desktop).
All interactive elements must have data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case (e.g. data-testid='add-contract-button').
DO NOT use forbidden fonts (Space Grotesk, Inter, Roboto) or forbidden dashboard colors (#1B93A4, #7351B7).
Ensure contrast ratios strictly meet WCAG AA / APCA standards. All hover states must explicitly set hover:text-white or hover:text-slate-900.
Use sonner for toast feedback on contract creation, planning generation, Google Calendar sync, and invoice PDF download.
Implement seamless Google Calendar sync state feedback (simulated / Emergent Google Auth flow integration) with sync history logs.
Provide a realistic OpenStreetMap geocoding simulation with distance grouping (e.g., grouping Milan sites together, Rome sites together) for travel optimization.
Include an Italian invoice generation module (Fattura finale PDF export) tailored for Italian technical consultants/freelancers.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic AI template looks with centered text or repetitive cards. Create crisp, high-density professional SaaS controls.
Do not apply transition: all globally. Apply targeted transitions on background, border-color, and opacity.
Never center align the primary app container (.App { text-align: center } is strictly forbidden).
All modals, popovers, and select dropdowns must have opaque backgrounds with backdrop blur (never fully transparent).
Ensure responsive padding (p-4 mobile to p-8 desktop) so text never touches container borders.
Keep interactive tap targets at minimum 44px height for touch accessibility.
